svg.text: ESP32 breakout board (screw terminals), DevKit plugged in
USB-C ← flat cable ← USB-C panel socket (connector side)
Coin cell CR2032 on the back
Labels as printed on the breakout board (P25 = GPIO25 …).
P0 = BOOT button – do not connect anything there.
220 Ω soldered into the red lead of each pigtail.
